title: fix(console): zh form titles space a Latin object name, the lookup create dialog has a title, the success toast names the action, money metrics keep currency decimals

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXevN4DpuBALL1b2DnF5gWK)_

Part of #30126

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 只做 #30126 的 items 1、2、3、7；其余条目不在本 PR。
- item 1：zh 的「新建/编辑/查看{{object}}」在对象名是拉丁文时补一个空格（「新建 Repair Ticket」），中文名不变（「新建联系人」）。做法是 i18n.ts 里按 key 列表生效的 zh postProcessor，语言包拼法不动。
- item 2：查找字段「新建关联记录」弹窗有了标题，复用 form.createTitle；作者写的 title 仍优先。
- item 3：默认成功提示说出动作名（「“解决”已完成」），新 key actions.completedNamed（10 个语言包）；无 label 的动作仍是通用文案。
- item 7：无 format 的金额指标按币种自身小数位显示（CNY ¥1,293.00、JPY ¥1,293），与列表单元格一致；根因在 core 的 dataset-format.ts，MetricWidget 静态卡同规则修。
- 门禁 35/35 exit 0，type-check 与 check:spec-symbols exit 0；五处消融各自变红；1440 宽 zh 前后截图见下。

## What changes

- **item 1, zh titles space a Latin object name.** `ui/packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts` registers an i18next post-processor that runs only for the keys in `CJK_LATIN_SPACED_KEYS` (`form.createTitle`, `form.editTitle`, `form.viewTitle`, `console.ai.recordWriteCreateTitle`, `console.ai.recordWriteUpdateTitle`) and only in `zh`. It pads the interpolated `object` value with a space on each side where a Latin letter or digit meets Han text. `新建{{object}}` stays the pack spelling, so the placeholder-spelling ruling (objectui#3512) holds.
- **item 2, the lookup's create dialog has a title.** `useActionModal`'s `{ objectName, mode: 'create' }` branch titles the form with `form.createTitle` and the object's label (the console's own New dialog title) when the descriptor has no `title`. An authored `title` wins; an edit form is not given one.
- **item 3, the default success toast names the action.** `ActionRunner.composeSuccessMessage`'s last rung reads the new key `actions.completedNamed` (`{{action}} completed`, zh `“{{action}}”已完成`) for an action with a `label`; an action with no label keeps `actions.completedSuccessfully`. The host still localizes the label before dispatch, so the toast carries the label the user saw on the button.
- **item 7, money metrics keep the currency's decimals.** `formatMeasure` (core `dataset-format.ts`) no longer passes `minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2` to a currency amount with no `format`, so Intl uses the currency's own minor-unit width. `MetricWidget`'s static card with a `currency` and no `format` gets the same rule instead of whole units. An authored `format` pattern still states its width.
- Changeset: patch for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`.

## Tests

- `i18n.test.ts`: zh 新建/编辑/查看 + `Repair Ticket` is spaced; `新建维修工单` is not; a key outside the table (`form.createSuccess`) is not; ja and en are untouched; unit cases for `spaceLatinValueFromCjk`.
- `useActionModal.objectCreateTitle-30126.test.tsx` (new): en `Create Repair Ticket`, zh `新建 Repair Ticket`, authored title wins, CONTROL edit form has no create title.
- `ActionRunner.defaultSuccessToast-10900.test.ts`: `Resolve completed` with no translator; the translator is asked for `actions.completedNamed` with `action`; an empty answer falls back to the filled English; a blank label keeps the generic line; `successMessage` still wins.
- `dataset-format.test.ts`: CNY 1293 → `¥1,293.00`, 1280.5 → `¥1,280.50`, JPY `¥1,293`, KWD three decimals, pattern `0,0` → `¥1,293`.
- `MetricWidget.numberFormat.test.tsx`: CNY `¥1,293.00` / `¥1,280.50`, JPY `¥1,293`, pattern `0,0` → `¥1,281`.
- Moved pins (each now reads the new behaviour): `RecordFormPage.i18n.test.tsx` (`新建 Contacts`, pack value still `新建{{object}}`), the two `flowDoneSuccessMessage-12274` tests (`Escalate case completed`), `ObjectView.toolbarScriptSelection-12331` (`Add to Campaign completed`), and `MetricWidget.numberFormat` (`$1,930,000.00`, `1.930.000,00 €`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope:** #30126 items 4, 5, 6 and 8 to 16 (server, CLI, re-measure, or held by other cards). Nothing here touches `packages/**`, `AppHeader.tsx` or `RecordDetailView`.
- **Mechanism deviation 1 (item 1):** an i18next formatter has to be spelled inside the pack value (`{{object, name}}`), which breaks the placeholder-spelling gate (`fallback-placeholder-spelling-3512.test.ts`, the objectui#3512 / #4135 ruling: packs use `{{name}}` only). A key-listed post-processor gives the same result with the pack unchanged; the seat agreed (claim amendment 2).
- **Mechanism deviation 2 (item 7):** the reported readings do not come from `MetricWidget.metricPatternDecimals`. They come from the dataset metric path, `DatasetWidget` → core `formatMeasure`, which passed `minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2` (code identical at the `@object-ui/*@18.3.0` release commit 83d7e4ae and on `main`). That pair is exactly what prints `¥1,280.5` for 1280.5 (the 18.3.0 report) and `¥1,293` for 1293.00 (the `main` report); `Intl` with no fraction options gives `¥1,280.50` / `¥1,293.00`. Re-measured live on `main` (989ae42d): `¥1,293` before, `¥1,293.00` after. The static `MetricWidget` card had the same gap in a different form (whole units, `¥1,281`), fixed by the same rule. The seat added `dataset-format.ts` to the surface.
- **Bounded in-place widening:** `form.editTitle`, `form.viewTitle` and `console.ai.recordWriteUpdateTitle` share the exact shape of `createTitle`, so they are in the key list too.
- **item 3 interpolation:** `completedNamedText` fills the one `{{action}}` hole with a single `String.replace` for the no-translator fallback; it is not a new general interpolator (the 3512 gate's needle list is unchanged).
- **Pre-existing:** `eslint` reports one error in `MetricWidget.tsx` (react-hooks "Cannot create components during render"); it is on base at line 419 too, not from this diff.
- New i18n key `actions.completedNamed` in all 10 packs is the Clause-② widening; no key is removed or renamed.

## Verification

- Head `70fc02c9` (`origin/main` merged; merge-tree against today's `main` is clean).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the changed paths: 35 derived families, all run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconcile: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `type-check` exit 0 for i18n, core, react, plugin-dashboard, app-shell (i18n and app-shell re-run after the merge). `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- vitest on the touched packages after the merge: 100/100 files, 1508 tests passed. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed (2 skipped), 4985 tests.
- Ablations (each reverted, `git diff HEAD` empty after): post-processor off → 1 failed; modal title off → 2 failed; named toast off → 3 failed; `formatMeasure` width back → 3 failed; `MetricWidget` width back → 4 failed.
